item.title: fix(ci): give the Vitest cache warmer the shard lanes' heap ceiling
item.summary: fix(ci): give the Vitest cache warmer the shard lanes' heap ceiling The warmer replays the same test envelopes as the compact shard lanes through scripts/ci-run-node-test-shard.mts, but without the lanes' NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192. Run 31874567859 lost a worker in agents-embedded-agent-run under the default heap and the failure skipped every cache-save post step, leaving the day's transform/compile caches unrefreshed. Rerun 31918467031 passed, confirming load-dependence; matching the lane environment removes the gap.
